method: 80/20 stratified holdout; exact normalized text duplicates removed; texts with conflicting labels excluded; TF-IDF word unigrams/bigrams + LinearSVC class_weight=balanced; only first 6000 characters used per resume; random_state=42
limitation: Metric is for the dataset's nine categories only and is not resume-to-job match accuracy. This evaluation is on a random holdout after duplicate/conflict cleaning, not an external dataset.
